subject: Evaluation & MAP: Close timeline, compliance add-ons
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Ethan Rodgers <ethan.rodgers@finedge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2025-11-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Evaluation kickoff + MAP draft and timing

Ethan —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Per our conversation, I’m attaching a first-pass evaluation plan and mutual action plan (MAP) focused on a six-week technical proof + commercial close cadence. High level:

- Week 0–2: Integration + test prompts (environment access, small pilot)
- Week 3–4: Load testing, latency/throughput validation, and model quality checklist
- Week 5: Security/compliance review (audit log samples, retention policies)
- Week 6: Executive review & sign-off — commercial commitment or next steps

Commercial framing: we can offer a ramped commit with milestone discounts tied to (1) signed 12-month committed throughput, and (2) active rollout to production by the end of ramp month 4. Example tiers included in the attached spreadsheet.

Compliance add-ons (requested on call):
- Audit logs export and retention: base 90-day retention is included; extended retention is available at $1,200/month per additional year of retention (pricing scales by seat/cluster — see sheet).
- Premium security controls (SAML SCIM + dedicated KMS + enhanced audit UI): one-time onboarding $8k, and $600/month thereafter.
- SOC 2 evidence pack: available as an add-on for $3k one-time (includes certified statements and sample logs).

Next actions: please review the MAP and pricing worksheet. If the timeline looks feasible for FinEdge, we’ll lock the dates and prepare a short DocuSign with the committed-tier term sheet to hold the discount.

Attachments: FinEdge-MAP-v1.pdf; FinEdge-compliance-addons-pricing.xlsx

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ethan Rodgers <ethan.rodgers@finedge.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finedge.ai>
Date: 2025-11-06T11:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff + MAP draft and timing

Ben —

Appreciate the draft. A few quick notes from our side:

1) Procurement window: our internal procurement requires signed T&Cs + SOW before start; can we get a draft SOW in parallel so legal doesn’t block week 1?
2) Retention ask: Finance and Compliance want the ability to retain logs up to 7 years for dispute resolution in EU/US markets — what would that look like pricing-wise?
3) Ramp: our product team wants a softer ramp (6 months to full commit) — can we achieve discount milestones tied to activation percentages rather than strict month 4 go-live?

We can commit to the proof timeline if legal and procurement get the documents this week. Priya — I’ve looped you to confirm budget authority.

Thanks,
Ethan
Head of Platform
FinEdge
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Ethan Rodgers <ethan.rodgers@finedge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: 2025-11-10T08:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff + MAP draft and timing

Ethan —

Thanks — noted. I’ve attached MAP v2 that adds a parallel SOW stub (to unblock procurement) and two alternate commercial schedules:

A) Accelerated commit (6-week ramp to production): 18% annual discount off list at 12-month commit; additional 4% credit if go-live by end of month 4.
B) Gradual ramp (6-month activation): 12% annual discount at 12-month commit; tiered step-up credits at 25% / 60% / 100% activation points.

Retention pricing for extended periods (summary):
- 1 year extension: $1,200/month
- 3 year extension: $3,000/month
- 7 year extension: $6,800/month (volume-adjusted estimate; final price subject to index on retained GB/month).

SOC 2 evidence: we can provide the SOC 2 pack ($3k one-time) and a sample audit-log export during week 5. Premium security controls remain $8k onboarding + $600/month.

On procurement: Monica will send the SOW stub and our standard commercial T&Cs to your procurement alias today. Once procurement confirms those are acceptable, we can keep the MAP schedule intact.

Attachments: FinEdge-MAP-v2.pdf; FinEdge-compliance-addons-pricing.xlsx

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff + MAP draft and timing — discount approval path

Ben / Monica —

We ran the two schedule options by pricing. Fast note on approvals and renewal language:

- The accelerated commit (18% + 4%) is approvable by pricing for deals >= $250k ARR. If FinEdge expects to be below that number we should default to the gradual ramp schedule.
- For extended retention (7 years), pricing team requires a minimum 12-month prepay or a revenue floor (to cover storage/egress risk). We should surface that in the MAP as a procurement checkbox.

I’ll mark the price sheet with the approval gate and add a recommended SOW clause for a prepay option for long retention.

Marissa
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finedge.ai>

Cc: Ethan Rodgers <ethan.rodgers@finedge.ai>
Date: 2025-11-14T09:52:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff + MAP draft and timing

Ben / team —

Quick update from our side: leadership has provisionally signed off on the PoC funding, conditional on three things:

1) We get the SOW and T&Cs before Monday so procurement can start review.
2) We receive a clearer long-retention price for 7 years that includes any compliance discounts for annual prepay.
3) We see a sample audit log export and proof of the retention UI during the security review in week 5.

If those are satisfied, we’re comfortable with the gradual ramp commercial schedule, and would request a 10% prepay hold (applied to year 1) for the 7-year retention option.

Priya Shah
VP Product, FinEdge

Subject: Final MAP proposal for signature — retention and premium controls pricing

Ethan / Priya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround this cycle. Based on procurement and pricing input, here is the final commercial proposal to close this round:

1) Agreement structure:
- 12-month committed term (DocuSign template linked) with activation-based credits if you choose the gradual ramp path.
- DocuSign: https://docusign.net/send/ABCDEF

2) Pricing summary (final):
- Base subscription (list): $0.025 / token (invoice units)
- Gradual ramp commit discount: 12% at signed 12-month commit; tiered credits at 25% / 60% / 100% activation (2%, 5%, 5%).

3) Compliance add-ons (final offer):
- 7-year audit log retention: $6,500/month (final price with 10% prepay applied to year 1). This includes retained raw logs + searchable index export (monthly).
- Premium security controls: $7,500 one-time onboarding + $575/month.
- SOC 2 evidence pack: $2,750 one-time.

4) Approval & gating:
- Pricing team has approved the above for FDG-2025-0912 conditioned on a $150k ARR floor to retain the extended retention price. If FinEdge expects annualized usage below that, we will revert to the volume-indexed pricing in the worksheet.

5) MAP milestones (finalized):
- Week 0: SOW & T&Cs executed (procurement sign-off)
- Week 1–2: Environment access + integration test
- Week 3–4: Load and quality validations; demonstration of audit log export
- Week 5: Security review — UI walkthrough + retention verification
- Week 6: Exec review and intent to commit

Next steps for closure:
- Priya: confirm you’re OK with the 10% prepay for the 7-year option as noted above.
- Ethan: if procurement signs SOW/T&Cs by EOD Monday we’ll issue the DocuSign with the agreed pricing and target to have countersigned agreement by 2025-11-25.

I’ve attached the final MAP and the pricing worksheet with approval gates called out. Please review; happy to hop on a short call if you want to walk the numbers.

Attachments: FinEdge-MAP-v2.pdf; FinEdge-compliance-addons-pricing.xlsx

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
